Two budgets · Kluang estimate

RM120–200kFull design, all-in
RM100kBudget version, all-in

Use the Full design / RM100k buttons to compare. The RM100k version keeps the layout, colours and kitchen island. It uses flat sage laminate doors instead of painted shaker, a bought bed and headboard instead of the tatami platform, and a fluted TV panel instead of the full slat wall. It has no window seat or terrace bench, and tiled bathrooms instead of microcement.

Material palette

Room by room · clear size, mm

    Design idea. One continuous light-oak floor ties living, dining and the bedrooms together, so the long narrow plan reads as one calm space. Dark walnut and charcoal pieces sit low and are kept few. Paper lanterns give warm, soft light, and plants and the terrace bring in green. Storage is built in full-height so surfaces stay clear.

    Accuracy. Room sizes are scaled from the image (±100 mm). Furniture sizes are standard catalogue sizes. Check door swings against the final dimensioned plan.
